name: Reverse: 1999
description: 129 Arcanists tracked across all six Afflatus types — 97 with real endgame performance ratings across every mode.

tierNotes.title: Source & methodology
tierNotes.body: Ratings come from the community Character Tier List (CN 3.9 / Global 3.7 data), converted from that sheet's 0–10 performance scores using its own published bands: 8+ is S+, 7+ is S, 6+ is A, 5+ is B, under 5 is C. "Overall" uses each Arcanist's Final Score (Base Score weighted by Team Multiplier). 32 newer or less-discussed Arcanists aren't in that tier list yet and stay unranked rather than guessed at.
